checks.name: a real existing tab uses the target release before its support period ends
ending support disables selection but preserves unchanged current paths and the existing tab
expired SDK/B selections and new indirect paths to expired D are rejected
switching away blocks reselection through stale apply, CLI and rollback while the old tab still runs
notice grace, request confirmation and same-origin controls are enforced before unregistration
UI unregistration removes the choice while leaving all artifact files and tab/rollback references intact
immediate deletion is blocked by post-unregistration retention, a live tab and rollback references
explicit rollback-retention release preserves snapshot evidence but blocks rollback and direct HTML boot
missing heartbeat remains a deletion blocker even after rollback retention and date conditions are cleared
confirmed tab closure releases its reference but restarts the quiet retention period
a published fixed consumer prevents deletion until its own stored files have been removed
deletion requires the exact release confirmation, external-use acknowledgement and current revision
a newly reported old tab after preparing deletion is caught by the server at commit time
explicit UI file deletion removes bytes only after all references and retention conditions clear
a symlink substitution cannot redirect file deletion outside the selected artifact directory
an interrupted deletion is recorded as incomplete and can resume without falsely reporting success
retirement and deletion records survive restart and render on mobile without overflow
all original projects and the live artifact repository remain unchanged

scope: Real browser/API and CLI in a fresh disposable store. Actual file removal, unchanged consumers, lifetime references and commit-time guards. Past timestamps are seeded only in test metadata; no production clock override.
fixedReferenceProbe: Metadata-only consumer fixture; guard and file deletion tested, fixture code not executed.
